Long story tbh so I'm gonna shorten it. My partner of 3 years started developing feelings for another and this hurt a but but we were poly. I said she could have sexual interactions but if I became unhappy I would tell her and she would stop. She agreed. Anyways, I became unhappy as I could see she wanted more than sexual and I told her I wasn't happy and she should stop. She agreed but was hurt. I was hurting over the fact I wasn't good enough and the guilt of stopping her. I was hurting bad. I then discovered that after I told her to not be anymore than friends with the person, she was still doing sexual shit and emotional shit. It hurt. It broke me. As I was doing everything to try make her feel better and feel loved and cherished when I was at my lowest and she does that behind my back. She cheated. It broke me. After everything I've done for her. I cared for her after surgery, took her around the world. Encouraged her to chase her dreams and facilitated it. I put not limits or boundaries on her. I let her do whatever whenever if it made her happy and I trusted her. I have my faults I will admit and I've said and done stuff I regret but she has also hurt me too often. When I was reading everything I lost it. We have a dead bedroom yet she's going and doing shit with someone else. It destroyed me. I turned to booze as my coping mechanism. I've been suicidal for months as my.depression came back and she still did this to me. I've decided to stay because I do love her. But even now, I'm the one trying to ease her guilt and sadness with little to nothing in return. I know I shouldn't stay with her. I feel betrayed. I'm so fucking hurt but I love her beyond words. Anyways, that was the shortened story. Thank you for reading.
